;; Test file for nREPL load-file operation
(ns test-load-file-jvm
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]))

(defn jvm-greeting 
  "A simple greeting function for JVM"
  [name]
  (str "JVM Hello, " name "!"))

(defn jvm-add-numbers
  "Add two numbers together on JVM"
  [a b]
  (+ a b))

(def jvm-test-data
  {:message "This JVM file was loaded successfully"
   :timestamp (System/currentTimeMillis)
   :jvm-version (System/getProperty "java.version")})

;; This should be accessible after loading
(defn jvm-loaded-marker []
  :jvm-file-successfully-loaded)

(println "test-load-file-jvm.clj loaded successfully on JVM!")
